name: wp-debloat
description: Evidence-based WordPress configuration auditing and safe, reversible debloating.

scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration:main && npm run test:integration:fail-probe
scripts.test:integration:main: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/wp-debloat php tools/phpunit-9.phar -c phpunit-wp.xml.dist
scripts.test:integration:fail-probe: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/wp-debloat php tools/phpunit-9.phar -c phpunit-wp-fail-probe.xml.dist
scripts.env:seed: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/wp-debloat wp eval-file tools/seed-fixture.php
